projects.name: e-Move
projects.desc: Route planner for electric cars. The API handles login with JWT in an HttpOnly cookie, a garage of 29 car models, range estimates and the LocationIQ and OpenChargeMap integrations.
projects.stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, JPA, MariaDB, Next.js
projects.alt: e-Move home page: the headline The Future of Electric Mobility over a photo of a car dashboard

projects.name: GreenTech ERP
projects.desc: Farm management ERP built by a team at FHO: greenhouses, planting batches, harvests, stock and climate logs, with access controlled by job title. The whole environment starts with one Docker Compose file.
projects.stack: Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL 16, JWT, Docker Compose
projects.alt: Part of the GreenTech class diagram: User, Funcionario, LotePlantio, Estoque and Colheita

projects.name: AI triage
projects.desc: Appointment reminders over WhatsApp for a dental clinic. A language model reads each patient's reply and either confirms or cancels in the scheduling system. When a reply is unclear, the conversation goes to a person.
projects.stack: n8n, Groq API, Ollama with Llama 3.1, Redis
projects.alt: WhatsApp conversation with three patient replies and the model's decision next to each

projects.name: CliniCare

projects.alt: CliniCare site: the headline about a perfect smile next to a photo of the reception room

stops.name: Container
stops.title: A container on Linux
stops.text: PUT /api/veiculos/1/bateria arrives on port 8080 of an Amazon Corretto 17 container on Alpine, running without root. I learned to set servers up like this running Linux infrastructure at Brascabos.

stops.name: Controller
stops.title: Filter and controller
stops.text: Spring Security checks the origin against CORS before letting the route through. VeiculoController reads the JWT to know who is asking, and answers 401 when it is missing.

stops.name: Service
stops.title: The business rule
stops.text: VeiculoService rejects levels outside 0 to 100 and works out the range. A Tesla Model 3 does 491 km on a full battery; at 80%, 392.8 km are left.

stops.name: Database
stops.title: Saved in one transaction
stops.text: With @Transactional, the JPA repository finds the user-vehicle link in MariaDB and saves the new level. If anything fails halfway, nothing is half-saved.

stops.name: Response
stops.title: 200 OK on the way back
stops.text: The VeiculoDTO comes back as JSON and the e-Move screen shows the new range. Further down, you can send this request yourself with another car.

intro.label: Introduction: from hardware to APIs
intro.hint: Scroll to see how I got here.

stops.title: I started with hardware
stops.text: At first I used built and repaired machines. That is where I wrote my first real system: an internal management tool in PHP with PostgreSQL.

stops.title: Then came the servers
stops.text: I spent over a year between Linux, Windows Server and Active Directory, reading incident logs and taking repetitive tasks off the team's hands with scripts.

stops.title: Today, APIs that run well
stops.text: When I build an API in Spring Boot, I think about how it will run on the server. Since January 2026 I have worked with freelance clients, and I study Information Systems at FHO.
stops.mark: how it will run on the server
